## Musik 1.11.0: Green theme

- **Themes +**: a new switch above the theme picker (Settings → General, and in the setup assistant). It shows extra themes and hides them again.
- **Green**: black background, green accent, round pill buttons, bold headings, a green play button on every page, a tab bar on a black fade and a mini player that takes the colour of the cover. Buttons grow a little on hover and press in when tapped. Green is always dark.
